# Hire Musicians

> A free online marketplace for hiring live musicians, focused on Austin, Texas (the Live Music Capital of the World).


## Core Functionality

- [Home](/) - Start here to find live musicians in Austin, Texas.
- [Live Music Search](/live-music/search) - The primary way to discover musicians. Filter by category, genre, subgenre, instrumentation, setting, ensemble size, and location.
- [Curated Locale & Category Pages](/live-music/search) - Location and style specific pages that highlight curated recommendations of musicians in Austin to help find the right act faster. Examples include:
  - [Austin Soul Bands](/austin/soul-bands)
  - [Austin Live Bands](/austin/live-bands)
  - [Austin Country Bands](/austin/country-bands)
  - [Austin Wedding Bands](/austin/wedding-bands)
  - [Austin Cover Bands](/austin/cover-bands)
  - [Austin Funk Bands](/austin/funk-bands)
  - [Austin Party Bands](/austin/party-bands)
- [Musician Listings](/live-music/search) - Each listing serves as an artist EPK, showcasing their bio, photos, videos, genres, instrumentation, location, reviews, and the ability to request a quote directly from their profile.
- [Get Quotes From Multiple Musicians](/) - Tell us about your event once and send your inquiry to multiple musicians at the same time to receive quotes back.


## Geographic Focus

- **Primary Market:** Austin, Texas


## API

- Find live music listings programmatically via the public API
- OpenAPI spec: [https://hiremusicians.com/openapi.json](https://hiremusicians.com/openapi.json)
- Endpoint: [GET https://hiremusicians.com/api/v1/musicians/live-music](https://hiremusicians.com/api/v1/musicians/live-music)
- Search by postal code (required `zip` param) and filter by `genres` and `ensemble_size`
- Returns only essential musician fields (name, genres, city, state, description, bio, thumbnail_url, permalink)
